name: Themes
author: VanillaGreen
description: A bar button that opens a panel listing every theme package and the wallpaper, and a full-screen theme browser on SUPER+T that lists every shipped, installed and catalog theme, installs and applies one, and offers its wallpapers, and a full-screen wallpaper browser on SUPER+W that sets the applied theme's or any wallpaper on every monitor or on one; the applied theme's wallpaper is drawn under every window.

placement.label: Placement
placement.description: Where the themes panel opens on its monitor when summoned without its bar button

setWindowBorders.label: Themes set window borders
setWindowBorders.description: Theme border colours, border thickness and shadow colour land in the VGS Hyprland layer; a user's own Hyprland setting after the include line still wins

setCornerRadius.label: Themes set corner radius
setCornerRadius.description: Theme window rounding and grouped-window tab rounding land in the VGS Hyprland layer; a user's own Hyprland setting after the include line still wins

setWindowAnimations.label: Themes set window animations
setWindowAnimations.description: Theme animation presets land in the VGS Hyprland layer; a user's own Hyprland setting after the include line still wins
